metadata.description: A curated Claude Code plugin marketplace of skills, agents, and hooks that benefit everyone. Vendor-neutral, general-purpose engineering and workflow standards you can install into any repo.

plugins.name: workflow-standards
plugins.description: Standards for how you work — with Claude and with your team. v0.1 ships sycophancy, a critical-thinking-partner mode that makes Claude challenge your reasoning by default instead of agreeing with you.

plugins.name: team
plugins.description: An autonomous engineering team in a box. A Director and Visionary report to you (the CEO) from the main conversation and steer 15 role agents — PM, EM, architect, tech lead, staff/backend/AI/platform/DevOps/security engineers, QA, tech writer, ops, finance, marketing — through pipelines with quality gates. Ships /team ceremonies, a per-project charter, a spend ledger with a £50 escalation gate, and guardrail + secret-scan hooks. Opinionated stack: Go, AWS, GitHub; every stack-level decision escalates to you.
